summary: Iteration 49 — ORRBBIT Control Centre production go-live configuration browser verified. All six requested flows pass. Env-banner (testID env-banner) renders as amber 'PREVIEW / TEST ENVIRONMENT' (bg rgb(180,83,9) = #B45309) on every visited page (overview, users, emails, reports). Operational Status card (testID ops-status) on the overview shows badges PREVIEW / TEST + Backend: Connected + Database: Connected + Email: Healthy, KPI cards Active users (24h)=20, Open reports=0, Pending credential reviews=4, Email failures (24h)=11, and the footer 'Last successful email: 2026-08-22 09:23 · Demo data excluded'. Demo isolation confirmed: DEMO mode users list shows 26 DEMO badges, switching via topbar triggers the 'Switch to LIVE mode?' confirmation modal, and after confirming LIVE the users list drops to 0 DEMO badges (env-banner remains amber PREVIEW — correctly independent of data-mode). RBAC on GET /api/control/status: no token → 401, bogus token → 401, valid app-user JWT (kauri@intro.demo) → 401 Invalid token, admin token → 200 with the expected payload (environment=preview, demo_data_excluded=true). Destructive safeguard: Ban button on a demo user opens the 'Ban this user? This hides them everywhere.' confirmation modal with Cancel/Confirm — action was NOT completed per instructions. No red screens, no console errors (only harmless RN-web shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings from library code).

critical_code_review_comments: Shell.tsx correctly derives IS_PREVIEW_ENV from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not from data-mode toggle) — banner will flip to green LIVE PRODUCTION automatically when the app is rebuilt against a non-preview backend URL.

app/control/index.tsx correctly wraps the Operational Status card only when /control/status returns; badges use status.environment==='production' so preview builds render 'PREVIEW / TEST' as expected.
GET /api/control/status is admin-only via existing require_admin dependency (verified — 401 for anon, bogus, and app-user JWTs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env-banner and ops-status are stable. When testing the LIVE-PRODUCTION green banner state, note that it will only appear once the app is rebuilt against a non-preview backend URL; in this preview environment it will always be amber by design.
